title: Vastu Compass: Home & Office
description:
Unlock Harmony and Prosperity with the Ultimate Spatial Wisdom Guide

Transform your living and working spaces into sources of positive energy with a comprehensive guide to ancient architectural principles. Whether you are moving into a new home, renovating an office, or optimizing your current layout, this tool provides the directional insights and traditional knowledge you need.

Key Features:

🧭 Precise Directional Compass
Go beyond basic navigation. Our accurate digital tool provides real-time mapping of traditional zones, including corresponding Deities and natural elements (Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Space) for every corner of your property.

🤖 Multilingual AI Assistant
Have a specific question about your layout? Chat with our intelligent assistant. Get instant, expert advice on room placements, remedies, and spatial adjustments—available in 12+ Indian languages including Hindi, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, and more.

🏠 Room-by-Room Guidelines
Detailed tips and "Sacred Areas" mapping for every part of your home:

Entrance: Welcome positive energy through the right threshold.
Kitchen: Align the fire element for health and nutrition.
Master Bedroom: Enhance stability and peace for better rest.
Prayer Room: Create a sacred center for spiritual growth.
Wealth & Treasury: Positioning tips to attract prosperity and protect assets.
🌿 Modern Living Solutions
Practical advice for modern apartments and offices, covering Color Psychology, mirror placements, and the importance of the Brahmasthan (the central energy core).

🌐 12+ Languages Supported
Access traditional wisdom in your mother tongue. We support: English, हिन्दी (Hindi), తెలుగు (Telugu), বাংলা (Bengali), मराठी (Marathi), தமிழ் (Tamil), ગુજરાતી (Gujarati), اردو (Urdu), ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada), ଓଡ଼ିଆ (Odia), മലയാളം (Malayalam), and ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (Punjabi).

✅ Ad-Free Experience
Enjoy a focused and peaceful study of your space. Watch a simple rewarded video to remove interruptions for up to 7 days, allowing you to optimize your environment in peace.

Why Choose This App?
The science of Vastu Shastra is about balancing the five elements of nature to bring health, wealth, and happiness. Our app combines this Vedic heritage with modern AI technology to give you a personalized directional guide in the palm of your hand.

Developed with ❤️ by Shankar Bros.

title: FloatPrompt: Teleprompter
description:
Read your scripts with ease while maintaining perfect eye contact with the camera.

Whether you are recording a vlog, presenting in a virtual meeting, or using a physical teleprompter glass rig, this app provides a clean and highly customizable script reading experience. Switch seamlessly between a classic full-screen display and a convenient floating widget overlay.

🌐 GLOBAL LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Speak and read in your native language! The app interface is fully localized and supports 12 major languages:

English, Español, Français, Deutsch, हिन्दी (Hindi), 中文 (Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese), العربية (Arabic), Русский (Russian), 한국어 (Korean), Bahasa Indonesia, and Português.
🌟 KEY FEATURES
1. Floating Widget Overlay
Multitask Seamlessly: Read your script while using your device's native camera app, social media recording tools, or video meeting platforms (such as Zoom, Teams, or Meet).
Adjustable Transparency: Control the opacity of the widget background so it doesn't block your view of other apps.
Fully Resizable & Draggable: Place the widget anywhere on your screen, keeping it close to your camera lens to maintain natural eye contact.
2. Classic Full-Screen Mode
Distraction-Free Reading: A dedicated full-screen layout designed for rehearsals, public speaking, presentations, and voiceovers.
Mirror / Reverse Text Support: Reverse the text horizontally to use the app with physical teleprompter glass rigs and beam splitter monitors.
3. Complete Text Customization
Adjustable Scroll Speed: Fine-tune the scrolling speed to match your natural speaking pace.
Font & Size Controls: Increase or decrease text size for comfortable reading at any distance.
Themes & Colors: Change the text color and background contrast to suit your lighting environment, including support for dark and light modes.
4. Easy Script Management
Quick Creation & Editing: Write, edit, and organize your scripts directly within the app.
Local Storage: Your scripts are stored securely on your device, ensuring privacy and offline accessibility.
🎬 WHO IS IT FOR?
Content Creators & Vloggers: Record high-quality videos for YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram without memorizing lines.
Business Professionals: Deliver polished presentations and participate in video calls without looking away from the screen.
Public Speakers: Rehearse speeches and adjust formatting to ensure a smooth, natural delivery.
Podcasters & Voice Artists: Read voiceover scripts without paper rustling sounds.
🔒 PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS
Draw Over Other Apps (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW): This permission is strictly used to display the floating teleprompter widget over other apps.
Your scripts are kept locally on your device and are never shared or uploaded to external servers.

title: Telugu Toolkit: All Utility
description:
Key Features & Tools:
1. Specialized Financial Calculators:
Village Interest Calculator: Calculate monthly interest based on local village customs (e.g., ₹2 or ₹3 per ₹100). Supports both Simple and Compound interest.
Gold & Silver Price: Get real-time gold and silver rates with automatic GST and making charges calculation to know the final price before you buy.
EMI Calculator: Plan your Home, Car, or Personal loans with a detailed monthly breakdown and amortization schedule.
GST Calculator: Instantly calculate GST (Inclusive or Exclusive) for billing and business needs.
SIP & Investment: Plan your future with our Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) and Percentage calculators.
2. Land & Unit Converters:
Land Converter: Specialized for local measurements! Convert between Acres, Guntas, Cents, Square Yards (Gajalu), and Square Feet effortlessly.
All-in-One Converter: High-speed conversion for Length, Weight (Mass), Temperature, Area, Time, Data, and Volume.
Number System: Convert between Decimal, Binary, Hex, and Octal systems.
3. Essential Daily Utilities:
Vastu Compass: Align your home and workspace with a built-in Vastu-compliant digital compass showing all major directions (Eeshanyam, Agneyam, etc.).
Age Calculator: Calculate your exact age in years, months, and days, and see how many days are left for your next birthday.
Fuel & Mileage: Calculate trip costs based on distance, fuel price, and your vehicle's mileage.
BMI Calculator: Monitor your health with our BMI calculator, complete with health status and ideal weight tips.
Unit Price Finder: Compare two products to find out which one offers the best value for your money.
4. Quick Links & Emergency Services:
State Portals: Direct access to Dharani (TS), Meebhoomi (AP), and Electricity Bill payments (TGSPDCL/APEPDCL).
Traffic E-Challan: Quickly check traffic fines for Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
Emergency Contact List: One-tap access to Police (100), Fire (101), Ambulance (108), Women Helpline (181), and more.
Why Choose Telugu Toolkit?
Fully Localized: Switch between Telugu and English with a single tap.
Beautiful & Modern UI: A clean, professional design that is easy on the eyes and supports Dark Mode.
Privacy First: No unnecessary permissions. Your data and privacy are our top priority.
Frequently Used Tools: The app learns your habits and puts your most-used tools right on the dashboard for quick access.
Completely Offline: Most calculators work 100% offline (except for real-time gold prices and external web portals).

Important Disclaimers:

Government Information: Telugu Toolkit is a private utility app and is not affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by any government entity. All links to government portals (such as Dharani, Meebhoomi, or E-Challan) are provided for public convenience only. Data is sourced directly from official public websites.

Health & Fitness: The BMI Calculator is for informational purposes only. It is not a medical device and must not be used for medical diagnosis, treatment, or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Please consult a healthcare professional for any health-related concerns.

 Financial Services: This app provides calculators only (Interest, EMI, GST). We do not provide, facilitate, or broker loans, banking services, or any other regulated financial products. All results are estimations based on user input.

title: FTP Server: WiFi
description:
FTP Server: WiFi allows you to access and manage your Android device files over a local wireless network. By using the File Transfer Protocol (FTP), this utility eliminates the need for physical USB cables when moving photos, videos, or documents between your phone and a computer.

Functional Features

Wireless Access: View internal storage and SD card directories on any compatible device within the same WiFi/WLAN network.

Multi-Platform Support: Compatible with Windows File Explorer, macOS Finder, and Linux file managers.

Network Settings: Configurable port numbers and support for anonymous or password-protected login.

Storage Management: Copy, paste, delete, and backup files directly from your desktop interface.

Connection Guide

Connect your Android device and computer to the same WiFi network.

Launch the app and initialize the server to generate a local IP address.

Enter the provided FTP URL (e.g., ftp://192.168.1.5:2221) into your computer's file manager.

Technical Requirements

Stable WiFi connection.

Local network permissions enabled on the device.

No root access required.

title: Telugu Calendar 2026: పంచాంగం
description:
While we strive for accuracy, users are encouraged to cross-verify important dates and timings with local Panchangam authorities or official sources. Experience a comprehensive and beautifully designed Telugu Calendar 2026, thoughtfully created for users in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. This app is designed to help you stay connected with traditional Telugu culture, Panchangam details, and devotional content in a simple and modern format.

Stay rooted in tradition with this all-in-one Telugu Panchangam app. Built with a clean and modern interface, it offers both Dark and Light modes for comfortable viewing anytime. Whether you're checking daily Tithi details or planning upcoming festivals, all essential information is easily accessible in one place.

🌙 Core Features

2026 Monthly Calendar View
View a clear monthly calendar highlighting Pournami, Amavasya, and major Telugu festivals.

Detailed Panchangam Information
Access daily Panchangam details such as Tithi, Nakshatram, Yogam, and Karanam, presented for easy understanding.

Daily Astrology
Read Rasi Phalalu for all 12 zodiac signs, along with daily and yearly astrology insights provided for reference purposes.

Devotional Collection
Explore a curated collection of Vedic slokas and stotrams with complete Telugu lyrics for daily spiritual practice.

Spiritual Wisdom
Read selected content from Hindu epics and Puranas, presented for educational and devotional interest.

🎨 Designed for Ease of Use

Modern Interface
Smooth, fast, and intuitive design inspired by Material 3 guidelines.

Offline Access
Access the calendar and core Panchangam details even without an internet connection.

Festival Alerts
Get reminders for important Telugu festivals (Pandugalu) and auspicious timings like Amrutha Kalam.

Location-Based Calculations
Sunrise, sunset, Rahu Kalam, and other timings are calculated based on regional location references.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: This app is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing any government entity. It is an independent application developed for informational and cultural purposes.

📚 DATA SOURCES:
All Panchangam (calendar) information, including Tithi, Nakshatra, Yogam, Karanam, and auspicious timings, is compiled from publicly available traditional Vedic astrology sources and verified against authoritative Panchangam references including:
• Drik Panchang (https://www.drikpanchang.com)
• Prokerala Panchangam (https://www.prokerala.com/astrology/panchang/)
• Traditional Telugu Panchangam publications
